violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the LG refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC located an extra thermometer and placed it in the refrigerator during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment. The staff present have a Food Handler Certification but there is no Certified food protection manager on site. The Food Handler certification CANNOT be used in lieu of a valid Food protection manager certification.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with the owner and showed her the County Health Department website where the requirements are clearly stated. Staff members have the option to take Full Service or Limited Food Protection Manager certification ( serving kitchen) from a Fairfax County accredited exam center. This needs to be complete in 10 days time and emailed to the address provided. Failure to do so may result in further enforcement actions. It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The concentration of the CHLORINE (BLEACH) solution was measured at > 200 ppm when tested with a chlorine test strip .This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION : Discussed and worked with the person in charge to discard the solution and create a new sanitizer solution with right concentration.Maintain the concentration of Chlorine solution at 50-200 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The facility is using CHLORINE solution as a sanitizer but person in charge was only able to provide a QUAT test strip , there are no chlorine strips at the facility to test the sanitizer solution. The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: EHS provided a few chlorine test strips to test the solution. The PIC will order the correct strips today. The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device.
